messages:
Maya: Quick UX review from today's design pass — wanted to surface a few things on the Credentials table and the rotate/revoke flows. Two high‑level items: row density on narrow widths, plus modal copy + undo affordance for revoke.

Eli: +1. The row feels visually heavy when two actions are visible. On a 720px width the row wraps and the overflow menu disappears. Screenshot: <https://figma.redwood/example|figma>

Sam: Re: keyboard nav — noticed tabbing jumps into the inline secret reveal before you can reach the kebab menu. Might be a tabindex order issue (inline reveal should come after actions). Also hover targets for the small icons are only 24px. Can we bump to 32px?

Rachel: A11y nits: danger banner in revoke modal fails 4.5:1 for small text. Also the modal currently traps focus but doesn't announce the intent clearly to screen readers. Recommend adding aria-modal="true" + an offscreen heading that reads the action: "Revoke API key: irreversible". Toast for undo should be keyboard-focusable.

Jordan: Implementation constraints: collapsing to a single kebab on narrow screens is doable. We should avoid moving the secret reveal into the kebab because customers rely on quick copy. But we can hide secondary labels and keep icons with accessible labels. Can handle 32px hit targets.

Maya: Proposed rotate modal copy (replace current):
```
Heading: Rotate API key
Body: Rotating will generate a new secret and immediately invalidate the existing one. Update any services that use this key.
Primary CTA: Rotate key
Secondary CTA: Cancel
Confirmation checkbox (opt-in): I will update services that use this key
```
Question: do we need an explicit rollback/undo? My thought: for revoke we show a 10s undo toast, for rotate we show an informative diff and optional grace window. Thoughts?

Eli: I like the checkbox to force conscious rotates. For revoke toast copy: "API key revoked — Undo? (10s)". Make sure it contains a clear focusable undo button.

Sam: Small CSS ask: add a subtle divider between primary and secondary actions in the row so the kebab doesn't feel like it's part of the key meta. 1px #E6E9EE should do it.

Rachel: +1 on undo toast being focusable. Also log the revoke event with a specific aria-live region update: "Credential revoked. Undo available." so screen reader users get the same affordance.

Maya: OK I'll update the Figma and create two tickets: (1) compact row behavior + tabindex fixes, (2) rotate/revoke copy + a11y + undo toast. @Jordan can you estimate effort for both?

Jordan: I'll look today, estimate by EOD. FYI deploy-bot: we have a small CI check for accessibility linting that might catch the contrast stuff automatically.

deploy-bot: Accessibility linter note: color-contrast failure possible on revoke modal — see rule A11Y:COLOR_CONTRAST.

Maya: Thanks all — will follow up with updated comps and the ticket links. :thumbsup:
